mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response that increases real interest rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint positive movement in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in monthly job gains (PAYEMS growth < 0.2%) signals economic weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS growth < 0.2%, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market and weak consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 500.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising and inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals a hawkish monetary policy tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 2.0%), a slowdown in quarterly GDP growth signals an impending economic deceleration that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth < 2.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
